newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates at steady to lower levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates at steady to lower levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none Thursday.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, no bid, offer 115 percent, no comparison.
- Two barges, St Louis, Mississippi River, next week, no bid, 95 percent offer, no comparison.
- One barge, St Louis, Mississippi, on station, no bid, offered 90 percent.
- Eight barges, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of May, bid one barge each at 117-1/2 percent of tariff, down 2-1/2 percentage points from Thursday, similar, offered at 125 percent, no comparison.
